$comment: Reviewed differences between uPortal 5.17 (tests/replay/fixtures/5.17) and the current build that are intended (docs/http-replay.md, 'Intended differences').

An entry matches an exchange by 'path' (glob, * matches anything), and optionally 'roles', 'method' and 'set' (crawl or suite), and one difference by 'field' (status, location, header:<name>, cookie:<name>, body, or a glob) and optionally its exact 'from' and 'to' values, regular expressions 'fromMatch' and 'toMatch' for them, or 'detail', a regular expression that every changed line of a JSON or HTML body must match.
An entry with 'security' instead matches a change in the security checks by its path (e.g. logins.admin.cas.password).
Every entry needs a 'reason' and a 'log' reference. Entries that match nothing are listed in the report so they can be removed.

differences.reason: Tomcat's default error page names the Tomcat version; uPortal-start runs Tomcat 9.0.122 instead of 8.5.100 (uPortal-start 2df5751). The rest of the error page must stay the same. 5.17 shows the version too (see the http-replay notes).

Error responses that uPortal writes as JSON (401, 403, 404 from the /api controllers) now say UTF-8. The same uPortal webapp on Tomcat 8.5 still says ISO-8859-1, so the change comes with Tomcat 9 (uPortal-start 2df5751); UTF-8 is what the bodies are.
/api/session.json reports the uPortal version, which is the built version instead of 5.17.9.
uPortal f301239691 (on master after 5.17.9) removes a capture-phase click handler that blocked Bootstrap dropdowns.

A portlet action without a handler reports the exception in the redirect; its class is now the vendored Portlet MVC's (uPortal 272a417fb3). The redirect is otherwise the same. That the portal puts an exception message into a URL is 5.17 behaviour (see the http-replay notes).

uPortal-start compiles the Respondr skins. master installs less ^3.13 and sass ^1.77 without a lockfile, so its CSS depends on the versions current on the day it is built. This branch installs the versions package-lock.json pins. The pages that use the CSS are compared on their own.

An unmapped GET under /api answered 405 with Allow: POST on 5.17, because the /api dispatcher also loads renderingServletContext.xml and its legacy handler mapping matched PortalController's /** for POST. uPortal 3127a82ab9 maps the servlet controllers with RequestMappingHandlerMapping, and the same requests now answer 404. To review with WS6.

uPortal bcc1d9139d removes the spring-js ResourceServlet, which served /resources/* from jars; nothing in the portal or the Playwright suite requested it. Its URLs answer 404 now. To review with WS6.
